context:
Goal: far fewer open sessions, so the ones in use are easy to find.
Problem (rule): decision session-tiers keeps a lane open until its PR lands, so about 95 handed lanes sit idle only to wait for a merge, and a recorded decision changes only on your word.
Based on (measured): about 95 of about 200 sweep replies were HANDED, 11:38-11:46 CST Nov 8 (coordinator's sweep).
Based on (read): step idle-lane-archive-at-merge has the runner archive each lane when its batch merges.
Departs from: session-tiers on main (a lane closes after its PR lands) — a lane closes when its PR is handed to the runner.
Meanwhile: lanes stay open, and the coordinator goes on.

options.gain: About 95 fewer open sessions now, and each lane closes as soon as its work is handed.
options.label: Archive at hand-off
options.lose: A PR the runner sends back needs a new lane, started from the same brief; the runner messages the coordinator when that happens.

options.gain: No change to session-tiers; the lane that wrote the PR is still there if it is sent back.
options.label: Keep the rule; archive at merge
options.lose: About 95 sessions stay open until their batches merge.

reply: 12:07 CST Nov 8: answered b in the coordinator's chat at 12:03 CST ("b is still the right answer -- A is not it's just you need that one lane to land that makes archiving faster and better"). Decision session-tiers stays. The fix is lane archive-guard-reads-agent-calls (step 766, now marked your priority), plus step idle-lane-archive-at-merge. Posted here by mistake after you had answered.
title: Archive a lane as soon as its PR is handed to the runner?
